definitions.short: to yawn , i.e. open wide (literally or figuratively)
definitions.full: H6473. paar [ מָּעַר ] verb open wide (the mouth) (Late Hebrew rarely = Biblical Hebrew, usually open bowels, go to stool; compare Jewish-Aramaic מְּעַר ; Arabic and Syriac = Biblical Hebrew, chasm ); — Qal Perfect of voracious greed, figurative 3feminine singular מִּיהָ וּפָֽעֲרָה Isa 5:14 (of Sheôl), 3 plural בְּפִיהֶם עָלַי מָּֽעֲרוּ (Ges § 119q ) Job 16:10 ; of eager desire (good sense), מָּֽעֲרוּ מִּיהֶם 29:23 , מִּיפָֿעַרְתִּי Psa 119:131 .
